task.description: Implement WF-02 batch 7 (stage 16) on branch feature/WF02-batch-7-20260816 per the CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR-approved design artefacts (all PASS, hard gate cleared). Implement DDL-04 (Idempotent batched backfill: backfill loop with IS NULL predicate + ctid ANY batches, one transaction per batch, NonIdempotentBackfill rejection, 5s batch slowdown halving with 500-row floor, stall escalation after 10 no-progress iterations, plat_migration_state recording), OBP-04 (Outbox gate hysteresis: close at cap, reopen at 80% low-water, plat_outbox_gate per-tenant state, EXECUTION_OUTBOX_GATE_OPENED event, 100-refusals/min and 300s escalation), ORD-03 (Sequence order guard: applied_seq+1 check under ORD-02 lock, conditional cursor advance, silent rollback, 60s gap sweeper to DEAD + DLQ routing, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), VLD-04 (Validation gate: semantic validation on draft save + /validate + promotion submit, semantically_valid verdict + CEL compiler version, 5s bound, DEFINITION_VALIDATED/DEFINITION_VALIDATION_FAILED events). Apply migrations via zig build migrate. Seed the event_type_registry entries the design requires (VLD-04: DEFINITION_VALIDATED/DEFINITION_VALIDATION_FAILED; OBP-04: EXECUTION_OUTBOX_GATE_OPENED; ORD-03: EXECUTION_CORRELATION_LAG/EXECUTION_CORRELATION_CONTENTION/EXECUTION_EFFECT_APPLIED if not already present). Run zig build and the requirement-specific test steps to verify compilation. Do NOT write frontend code (backend-only batch).
acceptance_criteria: All migrations for DDL-04/OBP-04/ORD-03/VLD-04 applied via zig build migrate
event_type_registry seeded with the required event types
DDL-04 backfill loop, OBP-04 gate hysteresis, ORD-03 order guard + gap sweeper, VLD-04 validation gate implemented per design
Result records the commit_sha_list and confirms the branch tip is pushed

result.summary: Implemented WF-02 batch 7 (stage 16): DDL-04 idempotent batched backfill (src/platform/backfill.zig), OBP-04 outbox gate hysteresis (src/outbox/gate.zig), ORD-03 order guard + gap sweeper (ordering cursor/consumer/sweeper + dlq EFFECT_CORRELATION), VLD-04 validation gate (src/validation/gate.zig). Applied migrations 1163-1166 via zig build migrate; seeded DEFINITION_VALIDATED/DEFINITION_VALIDATION_FAILED, EXECUTION_OUTBOX_GATE_OPENED, EXECUTION_CORRELATION_LAG/CONTENTION, EXECUTION_EFFECT_APPLIED (retain_forever). zig build / zig build test / error-set check / ddl04+obp04+vld04 integration tests all green; branch pushed.

issues.description: VLD-04 AC4 budget is enforced as a wall-clock bound around the pure validateDefinition; per-site preemptive cancellation would require modifying the VLD-01/02/03 pipeline, which the design explicitly forbids. GateResult.timeout.sites_compiled reports the graph node count.

VLD-04 runSemanticGate builds EnvInput from the stored graph only; the four env-source fetches (variable_schema, service catalog, modules, form fields) remain with the calling handlers, mirroring the shipped /validate handler.

zig build migrate applies only the public schema pass; event_type_registry is per-tenant, so its seeding is verified via the integration harness (bpm_test provisions tenant_default fresh) and applies to dev tenant schemas on provisioning. Dev bpm_dev tenant_default.event_type_registry lacks retention_class from pre-existing 1149 drift (not introduced by this batch).

OBP-01/02/03 (drainer/middleware callers of outbox/gate.zig) and the scheduler wiring for the sweeper/gate cadence are future requirements per the design; this batch ships the gate/sweeper modules + DB + event seeding, integration-tested at the table level.
